title: Trace any photo onto real paper
pin_title: Trace Any Photo Onto Paper: Linework (No Ads, No Subscription)
desc: Linework shows your photo or a template over the live camera view so you can trace it onto real paper with your own pencil. Lock the picture so it stays still, rest your hand on the screen, and record a timelapse. Tracing your own photos stays free; Linework Plus is a one-time purchase. On iPhone and Android.

title: Turn any photo into line art to trace
pin_title: Turn Any Photo Into a Sketch to Trace (Free App, iPhone & Android)
desc: Turn a photo into an outline on your phone, adjust the line style, then trace it onto paper with the camera overlay or the lightbox. Image processing happens on your device. Linework: Trace & Sketch, free to try on iPhone and Android.

title: Trace from your phone without it moving
pin_title: How to Trace a Picture From Your Phone Without It Moving
desc: Stand your phone securely on a glass or a stack of books above the paper, open the picture in Linework and tap Lock. Touch lock lets your hand rest on the screen, so the picture holds still while you draw. Free to try on iPhone and Android.
